IC4: Hepatitis C recurrence defined by the presence of abnormal liver function test, positive HCV-RNA, histological signs of hepatitis C recurrence.
IC6: Immunosuppression with tacrolimus [OR] and/or mycophenolate [OR] (Prednisone use is allowed at low dose, ≤10 mg/d).
IC7: Treatment naïve [OR] or treatment experienced (Peg-RBV [OR] or triple therapy).
